name: No-show Recovery Assistant
value_proposition: Turn a day's booking export into labelled no-show drafts with real open times and a consent check — the owner reviews and sends, and the kit never texts, emails, or books.
persona: A clinic, salon, fitness studio, or consultant with several no-shows a month.
problem: Missed appointments are lost revenue the same day, and the rebooking message usually never gets sent.
workflow: 1. The person writes recovery rules before any draft: which statuses are never a no-show (default cancelled, plus attended as a hard skip), the repeat no-show threshold including today, and clients who must never get a recovery message. PERSON DECIDES: when a miss becomes a policy case, and who is never contacted from this workflow.

2. The person exports one day's booking list as CSV with time, client, service, status, contact_pref, sms_consent, and prior_no_shows, plus the open slots that match those services. PERSON DECIDES: which columns to keep. Remove phone numbers, email addresses, card numbers, and any columns the workflow does not need. This is an export review, not a live Calendly, Square, Acuity, Google Calendar, or Twilio connection.

3. The person checks the data settings of their AI assistant (chat history, training use, and file retention) before pasting or uploading anything. File upload support differs by ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini plan, account, and admin settings. PERSON DECIDES: whether to paste the rows as text, upload a file, or not use AI for this data at all.
4. The person pastes the Confirm Attendance Prompt and their rules from the Consent and Repeat Policy Worksheet, then attaches or pastes the booking rows and open slots.

5. AI runs CONFIRM ATTENDANCE FIRST. It drafts only when status = no_show on the booking row. Attended and cancelled rows are skipped with a visible reason. PERSON DECIDES: whether a row marked no_show is actually a no-show before any message is considered.

6. For each confirmed no-show, AI checks sms_consent and contact_pref before any SMS wording. SMS drafts require sms_consent = yes and contact_pref = sms. Missing consent is NEEDS YOUR CHECK, not a text. Repeat no-shows at the owner's threshold are FLAG FOR POLICY with no recovery draft. Open times in a draft must appear in the open-slot list and match the missed service. PERSON DECIDES: whether a flagged client gets a last-chance note, a deposit policy, or no contact.

7. AI labels CONFIRMED (from the export), AI INTERPRETATION (for example an unknown late arrival when there is no arrival time), and RECOMMENDED ACTION separately. It does not invent phone numbers, emails, deposits, open times, or recovery rates. PERSON DECIDES: whether each recommended action happens.

8. The person uses the Send Review Checklist and checks every CONFIRMED field against the booking row before contacting anyone. PERSON DECIDES: whether to send, edit, hold, or skip. The person picks the recipient from their own contacts and sends from their own SMS or email tool. The Blueprint never sends, books, cancels, or charges.
before: Staff mean to follow up on no-shows but rarely do, and slots stay empty.
after: Each confirmed miss has a specific rebooking draft with real open times, skipped attended bookings, a consent check, and a human policy flag for repeat no-shows — and the owner still sends, or decides not to.

guided_demo.summary: A public, six-step walkthrough at /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant using a fictional five-row salon day dated 2026-10-14, with open Cut & color slots on Thu 2:00 and Fri 9:30 and no live calendar, SMS, or booking connection. CONFIRM ATTENDANCE FIRST skips A. Chen (attended) and S. Patel (cancelled), blocks SMS for M. Okonkwo (no consent), flags R. Kim for a third-miss policy decision, and produces one unsent SMS draft for J. Rivera that offers only matching open Cut & color times. Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled with text, not color alone. Every name, time, and status is invented.
steps: Step 1 of 6 - The day's bookings: show the fictional 5-row booking table (J. Rivera, A. Chen, M. Okonkwo, S. Patel, R. Kim) with as_of 2026-10-14, repeat_no_show_threshold 3, and the open-slot table (Thu 2:00 Cut & color, Fri 9:30 Cut & color, Thu 11:00 Consult, Fri 15:00 Color). Label the tables invented. State that no live calendar, SMS, Calendly, Square, Acuity, or Twilio account is attached.

Step 2 of 6 - Confirm attendance first: show the exact heading 'CONFIRM ATTENDANCE FIRST'. List J. Rivera as a confirmed no-show. List A. Chen as SKIPPED with text containing 'attended' and the exact sentence 'Do not message someone who attended.'. List S. Patel as SKIPPED with text containing 'cancelled'. List M. Okonkwo as SKIPPED FOR SMS with text containing 'sms_consent' and 'no'. List R. Kim as FLAG FOR POLICY with text containing 'prior_no_shows' and '2'.

Step 3 of 6 - Draft with real open slots: show the SMS draft 'Hi J., we missed you today. Would Thu 2:00 or Fri 9:30 work instead?'. Show the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. Show CONFIRMED text containing 'J. Rivera', '10:00', 'Cut & color', 'no_show', 'sms', and 'yes'. Show AI INTERPRETATION text containing 'no arrival time' and 'not a promise they remain open'. Show RECOMMENDED ACTION text containing 'Do not send this draft.'. Show that Thu 11:00 Consult is not offered because the service does not match.

Step 4 of 6 - Check the facts: open the J. Rivera row. A 'Check facts against the booking row' button shows three rows (status no_show vs no_show, sms_consent yes vs yes, open slots Thu 2:00 and Fri 9:30 vs Thu 2:00 Cut & color and Fri 9:30 Cut & color), each labelled with the text 'Matches'.

Step 5 of 6 - Repeat no-shows need a policy decision: show R. Kim still FLAG FOR POLICY with prior_no_shows 2. Show the exact sentence 'A third no-show is a policy decision, not an automatic text.'. Show M. Okonkwo still skipped for missing SMS consent. Show the exact sentence 'Confirm consent before any message.'. Show the sentence 'No deposit is charged from this kit.'.

Step 6 of 6 - You review and send: state the exact sentences 'You review and send. The kit changes nothing.' and 'Do not send this draft.'. Explain that the person picks the recipient from their own contacts and sends from their own SMS or email tool, or decides not to, and that nothing is sent, booked, cancelled, or paid automatically. Offer a link to the Premium kit labelled as private preview with sign-in required.

kit_contents.title: No-show Recovery Setup Checklist
kit_contents.purpose: Step-by-step setup for one review. It covers writing the repeat-no-show threshold and skip rules, exporting one day's bookings with time, client, service, status, contact_pref, sms_consent, prior_no_shows, and matching open slots, removing phone numbers, emails, and payment details, checking the AI tool's data settings before pasting or uploading, and the rule that this is an export review, not a live connector. It notes that file upload support differs by ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini plan, account, and admin settings, and that rows can be pasted as text instead.

kit_contents.title: Confirm Attendance Prompt
kit_contents.purpose: Copyable prompt that runs CONFIRM ATTENDANCE FIRST, drafts only when status = no_show, skips attended and cancelled rows with reasons, labels CONFIRMED, AI INTERPRETATION, and RECOMMENDED ACTION separately, and forbids messaging someone who attended, inventing status, sending, booking, or charging.

kit_contents.title: Rebooking Draft Prompt
kit_contents.purpose: Copyable prompt used only after attendance is confirmed. It requires sms_consent = yes and contact_pref = sms before any SMS wording, offers only open slots that match the missed service, flags repeat no-shows at the owner's threshold as FLAG FOR POLICY with no draft, and forbids sending, inventing phone numbers or open times, and any edit to the booking system.

kit_contents.title: Consent and Repeat Policy Worksheet
kit_contents.purpose: Browser-only form where the person sets the repeat no-show threshold including today, lists statuses that are never a no-show, and lists clients to always skip. It generates a copyable rules block to paste with the prompts. Nothing is saved to Atlas.

kit_contents.title: Recovery Log Template
kit_contents.purpose: Column layout (as_of, time, client, service, status, channel, sms_consent, prior_no_shows, slots_offered, action, outcome) with allowed action values skipped_attended, skipped_cancelled, skipped_no_consent, flagged_policy, drafted_not_sent, sent_by_owner, not_sent, allowed outcome values rebooked, no_reply, policy_hold, left_empty, and the fictional J. Rivera drafted_not_sent row from the guided demo. Includes a Copy CSV button so the person can start their own spreadsheet.

kit_contents.title: Send Review Checklist
kit_contents.purpose: Interactive, session-only checklist used before contacting anyone. It confirms that CONFIRM ATTENDANCE FIRST ran, that attended and cancelled rows were skipped, that each CONFIRMED field matches the booking row, that labels are separate, that SMS is drafted only with consent, that offered times match the open-slot list and the missed service, that repeat no-shows were flagged instead of auto-drafted, and that the person will send from their own tool themselves.

kit_contents.title: Fictional Sample Booking Export
kit_contents.purpose: The same fictional five-row booking CSV and open-slot rows used in the guided demo, labelled as fictional, with a Copy CSV button. The person can practice the full workflow in their AI tool before using real booking data.

kit_contents.title: Data and Safety Guidance
kit_contents.purpose: Rules for handling booking exports in AI tools: review data settings, remove phone numbers and emails, do not paste passwords or card numbers, do not text someone who attended, do not send SMS without consent, do not offer a slot that is not open or that does not match the service, and do not auto-message a repeat no-show. It also states that file upload support differs by plan and that nothing is sent, booked, cancelled, or paid automatically.

decision_rules: Write CONFIRM ATTENDANCE FIRST and apply it before any draft, open-slot offer, or policy flag.
Draft only when the booking row status is no_show. Show the matching row.
Skip any row whose status is attended. Show the reason 'attended; Do not message someone who attended.'.
Skip any row whose status is in the owner's never-a-no-show list (default cancelled). Show the reason 'cancelled; not a no-show' or the matching status.
If a remaining row is missing time, client, service, or status, or the same client appears twice at the same time, do not draft it. List it under NEEDS YOUR CHECK.
Do not invent phone numbers, email addresses, deposits, open times, arrival times, or recovery rates. Use only values from the file the person pasted.
SMS draft only when sms_consent = yes and contact_pref = sms. If sms_consent is no or missing, write NEEDS YOUR CHECK with 'no SMS consent on file' and do not draft SMS.
If contact_pref is email, do not draft SMS. If email consent is not in the export, write NEEDS YOUR CHECK. Do not assume email is allowed.
Offer a time only when it appears in the open-slot list and the slot's service matches the missed service. Do not offer a Consult slot for a Cut & color miss.
If no matching open slot exists, write NEEDS YOUR CHECK with 'no matching open slot'. Do not invent a time.

Flag a client when prior_no_shows plus this miss reaches the owner's repeat threshold (default 3, so prior_no_shows 2). Write FLAG FOR POLICY and do not draft a recovery message until the person decides.
Skip any client on the owner's always-skip list. Show the reason 'on your always-skip list'.
A missing arrival time is not proof the client was or was not running late. That guess is AI INTERPRETATION, not a CONFIRMED fact.
Open slots are listed as of the export. Do not promise they will still be open when the person sends.
The draft is a draft only. Do not send it. Do not book, cancel, or charge. Suggest a recovery-log row; the person adds it.
On a later run, start from a new export. Do not reuse a previous day's open slots or assume a prior draft was sent.
human_ai_boundary: AI compares each row's status to no_show. The person decides whether a marked no-show actually missed the visit before any message is considered.
AI writes CONFIRM ATTENDANCE FIRST and skips attended and cancelled rows. The person decides whether a cancellation should still get a courtesy note.
AI checks sms_consent and contact_pref before any SMS wording. The person holds the consent record and decides whether any channel is allowed.
AI offers only matching open slots from the export. The person checks those times against the live book before sending.
AI flags repeat no-shows at the threshold the owner wrote. The person decides the policy: last-chance note, deposit going forward, or no contact.
AI never chooses or sees the recipient phone number or email. The person addresses and sends every message from their own SMS or email tool, or decides not to.
AI never books, cancels, or charges. The person makes any booking change in their own calendar.
The person decides whether any recommended action happens.
safety: Nothing is sent, edited, cancelled, booked, or paid automatically. Every page states that the person reviews and sends, and that the kit changes nothing.

Atlas does not connect to Calendly, Square, Acuity, Google Calendar, Twilio, SMS, email, or any other vendor. It has no OAuth flow, no API call, and does not upload the person's data to any third party.

Before pasting or uploading exports to an AI tool, the person is told to review that tool's data settings (such as chat history, training use, and file retention) and to remove phone numbers, email addresses, card numbers, and other columns the workflow does not need.
The kit tells the person not to paste phone numbers, email addresses, account passwords, or payment card numbers into the AI tool.
File upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings. The kit says so and does not claim any plan includes a specific capability.

The kit tells the person not to message someone who attended, not to send SMS without consent, not to offer a slot that is not open or that does not match the service, and not to auto-message a repeat no-show.
All demo and sample data is fictional and labelled as fictional on the page.
Worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in the browser session only and are not saved to Atlas.
The pages contain no statistics, recovery rates, savings, ROI claims, prices, or checkout. Fictional appointment times such as 10:00 and Thu 2:00 are clock times, not dollar figures.
required_data_tools: Booking or calendar CSV export for one day, with time, client, service, status, contact_pref, sms_consent, and prior_no_shows
Open slots that name the service, weekday or date, and time
Contact preference and SMS consent status from the person's own records
Owner-written repeat-no-show threshold and skip rules
The owner's own SMS or email tool for sending
A file-capable AI assistant. File upload support differs by plan, account, and admin settings; rows can be pasted as text instead.

constraints: Private preview only. The guided demo lives at /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant and the Premium kit at /blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/kit. Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header navigation, or the sitemap.

The Premium kit requires requireUser from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement for this product. It is labelled "Premium · Private preview". It shows no Stripe price, checkout, or Buy Premium unless the product is already in PAID_PRODUCTS.
All sample data is fictional and labelled as fictional. No live connector, OAuth flow, API call, or upload to a third party.
AI prepares; the person decides. Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately. Nothing is sent, edited, cancelled, or paid automatically.
No invented statistics, savings, or ROI claims. ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini capabilities differ by plan; say so where it matters.

Product files live in app/blueprints/no-show-recovery-assistant/, components/premium/no-show-recovery-assistant/, and src/lib/premium/no-show-recovery-assistant/. Register the Blueprint in src/lib/blueprints.ts. Do not edit Daily Inbox, Collections product behavior, Stripe, or Production.
e2e/no-show-recovery-assistant/authenticated.spec.ts is read-only once it exists. Do not skip, weaken, or rewrite it. Authenticated QA uses automatic session refresh.
Keyboard accessible, visible labels, no horizontal scrolling at a phone-sized viewport, no console errors.
